content: {"praised":["Inventive gadgets turning everyday items into life‑saving contraptions.","Energetic, charismatic performance by Richard Dean Anderson.","Strong cult following and loyal fan base.","Intelligent, resourceful protagonist in action scenes.","Good writing and acting in early seasons."],"criticized":["Plot often thin and predictable.","Campy tone and overuse of stock footage.","Dated special effects in early seasons.","Writing suffers in later seasons, storylines become corny.","MacGyver portrayed as urban‑savior, losing original charm."]}
